githubAccountSentToAgent: Sent account {{name}} to the current agent
githubAccountAgentPrompt: Use the github skill to manage GitHub with account '{{name}}'. First run github whoami --account {{name}} to verify the identity, then wait for my next instruction. Never read, print, or expose the token.
githubAccountsSecurity: Tokens stay in ~/cicy-ai/db/github.json. The API only returns configuration status and the last four characters.
npmAccountsSubtitle: Manage the npm accounts in this host's npm.json that Agents use. Tokens are never echoed back to the page.
npmAccountsSecurity: Tokens stay in ~/cicy-ai/db/npm.json. The API only returns configuration status and the last four characters; "Use on this host" only writes them into ~/.npmrc.
npmAccountAgentPrompt: This host's npm account is now "{{name}}" (the token is already in ~/.npmrc). Run npm whoami to confirm the identity, then wait for my next instruction. Never read, print, or leak the tokens in ~/.npmrc or ~/cicy-ai/db/npm.json.
npmInspectPartial: some details are not readable with this token
dockerAccountsSubtitle: Manage the registry accounts in this host's docker.json that Agents use. Tokens are never echoed back to the page.
dockerAccountsSecurity: Tokens stay in ~/cicy-ai/db/docker.json. The API only returns configuration status and the last four characters; "Use on this host" only writes them into ~/.docker/config.json.
dockerAccountUsername: Login name (defaults to the account name)
dockerAccountAgentPrompt: This host's Docker credentials are now "{{name}}" (already written to ~/.docker/config.json). Run docker system info | grep Username to confirm the identity, then wait for my next instruction. Never read, print, or leak the credentials in ~/.docker/config.json or ~/cicy-ai/db/docker.json.
aliyunAccountsSubtitle: Manage the AccessKeys in this host's aliyun.json that Agents use. Secrets are never echoed back to the page.
aliyunAccountsSecurity: AccessKey secrets stay in ~/cicy-ai/db/aliyun.json. The API only returns configuration status and the last four characters; "Use on this host" only writes them into ~/.aliyun/config.json.
aliyunAccountAgentPrompt: This host's Aliyun CLI profile is now "{{name}}" (the AccessKey is already in ~/.aliyun/config.json). Run aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity to confirm the identity, then wait for my next instruction. Never read, print, or leak the AccessKey secret.
aliyunInspectPartial: some details are not readable with this AccessKey

cloudNotLoggedInHint: Sign in so this cicy-code can talk to your other instances.
cloudLoginExpired: The sign-in link expired, send it again
cloudInstancesEmpty: No other instances yet. Sign in with the same email on another machine and it shows up here.
cloudLoginEmailHelp: Open the link in the email and this cicy-code signs in by itself.
cloudLoginMailHint: Open {{email}} and click the sign-in link; this page completes the binding automatically.
cloudProxyOffline: Tunnel not reporting; the domain is unavailable right now
cloudLoginCodeHint: Open {{email}}: click the link, or type the 6-digit code from the mail below.
settingsLanguageHint: Choose the interface language — applies immediately.
settingsRoutingHint: Assign a default provider and model per agent type on the left. Manage providers under “LLM Providers”.
settingsPublicUrlHint: This machine's externally reachable address (tunnel domain or LAN IP). Once set, a “scan to open on mobile” QR appears in the corner; leave empty to hide it.
settingsCodexAuthHint: Paste Codex Auth Base64 to decode, validate, and overwrite ~/.codex/auth.json.
settingsCodexAuthConfirmBody: This overwrites ~/.codex/auth.json with the pasted content. Running Codex processes are unaffected; newly started Codex processes use the new credential.
settingsCodexAuthSuccess: Overwritten. Newly started Codex processes will use the new credential.
settingsCodexAuthFailed: Overwrite failed. Make sure the value is valid Codex Auth Base64.
settingsClaudeAuthHint: Paste the Claude Auth Base64; it is decoded, validated and written over ~/.claude/.credentials.json.
settingsClaudeAuthConfirmBody: This overwrites ~/.claude/.credentials.json with the value you pasted. Running Claude processes are unaffected; ones started afterwards use the new credential.
settingsClaudeAuthSuccess: Overwritten. Claude processes started from now on use the new credential.
settingsClaudeAuthFailed: Overwrite failed. Check that the value is a valid Claude Auth Base64.
subscribeRemoveConfirm: Remove team source "{{name}}". Installed skills stay on disk but won't update from this source.
